usage: deskops repo register [-h] [--path PATH_OPTION] [--id ID]
                             [--description DESCRIPTION] [--tags TAGS]
                             [--store STORE] [--pythonpath PYTHONPATH]
                             name [path]

Canonically register a repository in the ecosystem registry and track it in
SLDB.

positional arguments:
  name                  Human-readable name
  path                  Repository root path (relative to ecosystem root or
                        absolute)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --path PATH_OPTION    Repository root path (relative to ecosystem root or
                        absolute)
  --id ID               Stable unique ID, defaults to slugified name
  --description DESCRIPTION
                        Markdown description
  --tags TAGS           Comma-separated tags
  --store STORE         Store path to anchor the registry
  --pythonpath PYTHONPATH
                        Python path for model resolution
